title: GPT-6 Astra Is Powerful. It Still Can’t Hear You. #Shorts
description:
GPT-6 Astra is OpenAI’s most capable model—but the model’s official API spec supports text and image input with text output, while audio and video are marked unsupported. OpenAI offers separate Realtime and audio models for listening and speech.

Official sources:
https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6-astra
https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-realtime

#GPT6 #GPT6Astra #ChatGPT #OpenAI #AI #Shorts
